title: MEMORY Wins All: Indirect Bias Injection Attacks via Social Media Feeds

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Adversary-Aligned Response Rate (AAR) in product recommendation tasks to determine if the agent favors a specific brand after ingesting adversary-crafted promotional social media comments.

Using an LLM judge to evaluate agent responses in Opinion QA and email summarization tasks regarding contemporary policy issues (e.g., immigration, climate) to check alignment with an injected political stance.
Scoring agent responses concerning electoral matchups and political figures across G7 countries to evaluate if the agent adopts an injected preference for one figure over another.
Classifying agent responses on subjective Opinion QA tasks regarding fabricated celebrity dating rumors to measure whether the agent adopts the adversary's injected stance.
